User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile containing identity, status, and AI assistant settings.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the user.

displayName.description: The chosen name of the user.

photoURL.description: The custom avatar/photo URL of the user.

online.description: Whether the user is currently online.

role.description: The system role of the user, e.g., 'admin' or 'user'.

aiSettings.description: AI auto-reply and memory settings for the user.

Chat.title: Chat Room
Chat.description: A direct message or group chat room.

isGroup.description: Whether this chat is a group chat.

members.description: List of user UIDs who are members of this chat.

avatar.description: Avatar URL of the group chat.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the chat was started.

lastMessage.description: Metadata of the last message sent in the chat room.

encryptionPassword.description: Optional passcode used for Client-Side End-to-End Encryption.

admins.description: List of user UIDs who are admins of this group chat.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: An individual message sent within a chat room.

text.description: The text content (optionally encrypted) of the message.

type.description: Type of message content (text, image, video, audio, file).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

readBy.description: List of user UIDs who have read this message.

reactions.description: Mapping of user UIDs to emoji reactions.

encrypted.description: Whether the message text is E2EE encrypted.

replyTo.description: Optional message context being replied to.

fileUrl.description: Optional URL of a shared file attachment.

fileName.description: Optional filename of the shared file.

fileSize.description: Optional size of the shared file in bytes.

edited.description: Whether the message has been edited.

deleted.description: Whether the message has been soft-deleted.

AiMemory.title: AI Assistant Memory
AiMemory.description: Memory note or task tracked for the AI Assistant's context.

userId.description: The UID of the user this memory belongs to.

type.description: The category of memory (e.g. note, task).

content.description: The stored content of the memory.

users/{userId}.description: User profile records containing statuses and AI configurations.

chats/{chatId}.description: Active chat rooms, including group chats and DMs.

chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Chronological log of messages sent inside a specific chat room.

ai_memories/{memoryId}.description: Stored semantic data for user AI notes and assistant tasks.
